text: DRUG INTERACTIONS SEE WARNINGS AND PRECAUTIONS FOR INTERACTION WITH CNS DRUGS AND ALCOHOL. METHOCARBAMOL MAY INHIBIT THE EFFECT OF PYRIDOSTIGMINE BROMIDE.
